### [Sommarläsning med Din Skog][7]

Tidningen Din Skogs sommarnummer bjuder på en stor valspecial där riksdagspartierna svarar på

[Läs fler nyheter][8]

## Vi skapar vår framtid idag

Hos oss möts tradition och innovation i en hållbar framtidsbransch, där vi tar hand om både skogen
och människorna som arbetar med den. Våra verksamheter finns i norra Sverige, men våra hållbara
produkter finns över hela världen. Vårt arbete idag ger positiva avtryck för en fossilfri värld och
det sporrar oss att göra bättre, varje dag. Som arbetsgivare erbjuder vi en trygg, utvecklande
arbetsplats med säkerhet i fokus och stöd för din framtida utveckling.

På SCA är hållbarhet mer än ett mål, det är en självklar del av allt vi gör. Från skogen till färdig
produkt tar vi vara på hela trädet och ser till att varje fiber används på bästa sätt. Vi vårdar
naturen med omtanke, stärker den biologiska mångfalden och utvecklar lösningar som gör verklig
skillnad för klimatet. Vår drivkraft är att skapa värde som växer över tid, för människor, samhällen
och framtida generationer.

### [Sommarläsning med Din Skog][7]

Tidningen Din Skogs sommarnummer bjuder på en stor valspecial där riksdagspartierna svarar på
angelägna skogsfrågor. Du får följa med på gränskontroll i skogen och du får även veta hur en
plantuppföljning går till. Dessutom har vi provat getyoga.

[Läs fler nyheter][8]

## Vi skapar vår framtid idag

Hos oss möts tradition och innovation i en hållbar framtidsbransch, där vi tar hand om både skogen
och människorna som arbetar med den. Våra verksamheter finns i norra Sverige, men våra hållbara
produkter finns över hela världen. Vårt arbete idag ger positiva avtryck för en fossilfri värld och
det sporrar oss att göra bättre, varje dag. Som arbetsgivare erbjuder vi en trygg, utvecklande
arbetsplats med säkerhet i fokus och stöd för din framtida utveckling.

[Läs mer på våra karriärsidor][9]

På SCA är hållbarhet mer än ett mål, det är en självklar del av allt vi gör. Från skogen till färdig

### Dedicated to moving forward.

For more than three decades, Berk International has sought to offer cutting-edge cleaning solutions.
We're proud to have received many accolades in our pursuit to create more sustainable disposable
products. For more than six years in a row, Berk International found its place on the Inc 500/5000
list. We've also climbed to the Philadelphia 100 list, and taken home the title of Best Run Company
from the Smart CEO 100. Regionally, Berk has claimed the Tri-County Chamber of Commerce Economic
Development Award. Most recently, Berk has taken the titles of the Sanitary Maintenance Distributor
Choice Award, the Philly Inquirer Family Owned Business Award, and the WOW Innovation Award in 2020.
Each day, the Berk family renews its dedication to sustainable manufacturing and creating better
products for a brighter future.

[➤ Explore Our Accolades ][77]

### Committed to giving back.

At Berk, we believe that nurturing our environment and cultivating our local communities is a
responsibility that we all share together. With the help of several organizations who support our
vision and mission for a greater tomorrow, we strive to spread health and wellness in all that we
do. In our mission to give back, we commit financially to supporting what we consider to be some of
the world's finest charities and causes.

As part of our dedication to pay it forward, Berk International is proud to provide over 39
charitable causes with financial gifts on behalf of the Berk International team. These charities and
causes include the American Cancer Society, Big Brothers Big Sisters, Make-A-Wish, and The Smile
Train. With every contribution, we're reminded how important it is to support the communities that
make Berk's success possible.

## LEARN MORE ABOUT CARDINAL TISSUE

**Founded in 2018 by Vince Reese, Cardinal Tissue has quickly become a leader in the tissue
manufacturing industry. While currently headquartered in Spindale, North Carolina, our company has
continued to aggressively expand its operations within the Southeastern United States by adding
these additional locations:**


* **Rutherfordton, North Carolina (Warehousing and Distribution)**
* **Rock Hill, South Carolina (Manufacturing)**
* **Palatka, Florida (Manufacturing)**



**The Rock Hill and Palatka facilities are a result of Cardinal Tissue’s acquisition of Softex
Paper’s US assets in 2025, which marks a significant milestone in the company’s growth plan and
commitment to enhancing its customer offerings.  **



**Cardinal Tissue's Current Capabilities:**


* **Four locations that represent a combined total of over 1,000,000 million square feet under
  roof.**
* **Contract tissue manufacturer that provides best in class tissue suppliers with solutions for
  contract converting and supply chain optimization. **
* **Unique expertise in augmenting supplier production needs for all categories and tiers of retail
  tissue products, such as toilet paper, paper towels, napkins, and facial tissue.**
* **Provider of training and technical support for converting optimization, new construction
  modernization of equipment, as well as contract tolling agreements. **

**Do you want to know why toilet paper demand spiked 845% during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020? It

Reese, was interviewed by Business Insider, and in this video he explains why this shortage occurred

# Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

### Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

### Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

### Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

### Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

### Breaking News: Cardinal Tissue LLC Acquires Softex Paper's US Assets in Strategic Expansion

][25]

## LEARN MORE ABOUT CARDINAL TISSUE

**Founded in 2018 by Vince Reese, Cardinal Tissue has quickly become a leader in the tissue
manufacturing industry. While currently headquartered in Spindale, North Carolina, our company has
continued to aggressively expand its operations within the Southeastern United States by adding
these additional locations:**


* **Rutherfordton, North Carolina (Warehousing and Distribution)**
* **Rock Hill, South Carolina (Manufacturing)**
* **Palatka, Florida (Manufacturing)**



**The Rock Hill and Palatka facilities are a result of Cardinal Tissue’s acquisition of Softex
Paper’s US assets in 2025, which marks a significant milestone in the company’s growth plan and
commitment to enhancing its customer offerings.  **



**Cardinal Tissue's Current Capabilities:**


* **Four locations that represent a combined total of over 1,000,000 million square feet under
  roof.**
* **Contract tissue manufacturer that provides best in class tissue suppliers with solutions for
  contract converting and supply chain optimization. **
* **Unique expertise in augmenting supplier production needs for all categories and tiers of retail
  tissue products, such as toilet paper, paper towels, napkins, and facial tissue.**
* **Provider of training and technical support for converting optimization, new construction
  modernization of equipment, as well as contract tolling agreements. **

## CARDINAL TISSUE VIDEOS

#### Cardinal Tissue’s Strategic Focus On The "Bottom" Line

#### Cardinal Tissue: We Are On A "Roll"

#### Cardinal Tissue Is "Wiping" Away the Competition With Fabio Perini's Constellation S6

## How Cardinal Tissue Saved Everyone's Butts During Covid-19

**Do you want to know why toilet paper demand spiked 845% during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020? It
wasn't just hoarders who were to blame for the shortage during that time. Cardinal Tissue CEO, Vince
Reese, was interviewed by Business Insider, and in this video he explains why this shortage occurred
and how Cardinal Tissue worked creatively to keep up with the increased demand.  **

production management, we balance quality and environmental responsibility. Our products mainly use
traceable virgin pulp from sustainably managed forests. We also use recycled pulp for some products,
promoting resource circularity.

process. From **product consultation and performance testing to production management, quality
inspection, packaging optimization, logistics, and after-sales support**, our team carefully manages

recommendations for different applications, such as **industrial packaging, publishing and printing,
and food packaging**. This includes advice on sizes, grammage, coating, and processing methods.

Our services

This is how we roll.

01

### Roller Engraving

Laser engraving, traditional machine engraving, and chemical etching. We match the method to your
material, your pattern depth and your production requirements, not the other way around.

[Learn About Roller Engraving][48]
02

### Repair & Refurbishment

Most rollers can be brought back to production standard at 15–40% of replacement cost. Our engravers
will give you an honest assessment (e.g. refurbish or replace) and turn it around fast.

[Learn About Repair & Refurbishment][49]
03

### Pattern Design & Development

From mood board to finished cylinder. Our 900mm pilot embossing machine lets you trial your pattern
on your actual substrate e.g. paper, vinyl, nonwoven, leather, foil before a production roller is
committed. No guesswork.

[Learn About Pattern Development][50]
04

### Ancillary Services

Anilox rollers with a screening library from 16 to 250 LPI. Chrome plating and de-chroming. Rubber
roller supply and refurbishment. Custom rolls for coating, laminating, printing, and heat transfer.

[Learn About Ancillary Services][51]
05

### 3D Pattern Scanning

Capture physical surface detail from samples, worn rollers and existing textures so it can be
reviewed, compared, preserved or developed into the next manufacturing step.

[Learn About Pattern Scanning][52]

### Roller Engraving

Laser engraving, traditional machine engraving, and chemical etching. We match the method to your
material, your pattern depth and your production requirements, not the other way around.

[Learn About Roller Engraving][48]
02

### Repair & Refurbishment

Most rollers can be brought back to production standard at 15–40% of replacement cost. Our engravers
will give you an honest assessment (e.g. refurbish or replace) and turn it around fast.

[Learn About Repair & Refurbishment][49]
03

### Pattern Design & Development

From mood board to finished cylinder. Our 900mm pilot embossing machine lets you trial your pattern
on your actual substrate e.g. paper, vinyl, nonwoven, leather, foil before a production roller is
committed. No guesswork.

[Learn About Pattern Development][50]
04

### Ancillary Services

Anilox rollers with a screening library from 16 to 250 LPI. Chrome plating and de-chroming. Rubber
roller supply and refurbishment. Custom rolls for coating, laminating, printing, and heat transfer.

[Learn About Ancillary Services][51]
05

### 3D Pattern Scanning

Capture physical surface detail from samples, worn rollers and existing textures so it can be
reviewed, compared, preserved or developed into the next manufacturing step.

[Learn About Pattern Scanning][52]

# products for all of life’s moments.

#### business needs and your customers’ expectations.

Global Tissue Group is your turnkey, one-stop shop for quality household paper products. With
innovation, integrity, and a commitment to excellence, we’ve become a trusted partner for top
retailers nationwide.

## A complete line

## of paper products for

## every customer need

We offer a versatile selection of household paper products for every price point and use case,
designed to meet the demands of all customers and market segments.

From value-tier to ultra-premium, we provide quality, consistency and customization you can trust.

Reliable, absorbent, and offered in a range of designs, including four-color print options

stand out on shelves. From private brand solutions to contract manufacturing, Global Tissue is your
all-in-one resource for speed, flexibility, and creativity.

## About US

Shandong Meidi Medical Supplies Co., Ltd. ("Meidi Medical") has been deeply engaged in the field of
medical cleaning and nursing paper for 28 years, integrating research and development,
manufacturing, branding and service, and continuously providing safe and stable disposable paper
product solutions for global customers. Our company's products are widely used in various channels
such as hospitals, large supermarkets, pet breeding centers, medical beauty institutions, fruit and
vegetable production, e-commerce platforms, and commercial cleaning. With "medical grade hygiene
standards" as the core, we bring a more reassuring paper experience to medical, home, and commercial
scenarios.

## Advantage**Product advantages**

30
Year Factory

Since its establishment, with three decades of deep industry expertise, Meidi has evolved into a
comprehensive and trusted partner in the household paper sector. We integrate R&D, manufacturing,
sales, and service to serve as your one-stop reliable choice for premium wiping paper solutions.

100000
GMP Class 100,000 Cleanroom

Core production is conducted in a 100,000-class cleanroom environment. This ensures our products
meet stringent requirements for low particulate and low microbial counts from the very source,
providing a clean and reliable guarantee for high-end medical device packaging and sterile
healthcare products.

15
Dedicated Production Lines

We operate 15 specialized production lines. This setup provides formidable production capacity and
flexible configuration, enabling us to efficiently fulfill orders ranging from large-scale volume
demands to customized needs with rapid response, ensuring reliable and on-time delivery.

8000 *m²*
Production

Our 8,000㎡ production base is operated by a dedicated team of 50+ experienced professionals. This
combination of substantial infrastructure and focused workforce ensures not only efficient workflow
and scalable capacity, but also consistent, hands-on expertise throughout every stage of your order
— from planning to delivery.
* [
  [jlblock35]
  
  ### Industry Advantages
  
  Specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of medical-grade hygiene papers, our core offerings
  include medical hand towels, postpartum care pads, ultrasound wipes, and disposable facial wipes.
  Equipped with patented 5C cleanroom technology and a GMP Class 100,000 sterile workshop, we ensure
  product safety and efficacy. Our extensive product line features diverse specifications to meet
  varied application needs. With partnerships spanning over 300 top-tier hospitals, we have earned
  widespread market recognition.
  
  ][164]
* [
  [jlblock36]
  
  ### Research and Development Expenditures
  
  The company is deeply committed to the research and development of antimicrobial, sterilization,
  and disinfection processes for paper products, offering multiple reliable solutions including
  high-temperature treatment, ethylene oxide sterilization, irradiation, and quaternary ammonium
  compounds. We enforce internal cleanliness standards far exceeding industry and corporate
  benchmarks (colony count <5), ensuring the foundational safety of our products. Our proprietary
  “Crystal Diamond Embossing” technology leads the industry, and through continuous R&D, we pursue
  higher standards to empower products to achieve comprehensive excellence—from safety to user
  experience.
  
  ][165]
* [
  [jlblock37]
  
  ### OEM/ODM
  
  We offer one-stop services ranging from standard products to deep customization. Whether it's
  product specifications, packaging design, wholesale, or OEM/ODM partnerships, we provide flexible
  solutions. Transparency is the cornerstone of our collaboration: from raw material selection and
  production processes to final delivery, every critical step is transparently accessible to clients
  for real-time tracking and traceability. You can monitor production progress and quality details
  at any time, enabling fully visual communication throughout the process. This ensures every stage
  meets expectations and standards, making collaboration more efficient and worry-free.

## About US

Shandong Meidi Medical Supplies Co., Ltd. ("Meidi Medical") has been deeply engaged in the field of
medical cleaning and nursing paper for 28 years, integrating research and development,
manufacturing, branding and service, and continuously providing safe and stable disposable paper
product solutions for global customers. Our company's products are widely used in various channels
such as hospitals, large supermarkets, pet breeding centers, medical beauty institutions, fruit and
vegetable production, e-commerce platforms, and commercial cleaning. With "medical grade hygiene
standards" as the core, we bring a more reassuring paper experience to medical, home, and commercial
scenarios.

## Advantage**Product advantages**

30
Year Factory

Since its establishment, with three decades of deep industry expertise, Meidi has evolved into a
comprehensive and trusted partner in the household paper sector. We integrate R&D, manufacturing,
sales, and service to serve as your one-stop reliable choice for premium wiping paper solutions.

100000
GMP Class 100,000 Cleanroom

Core production is conducted in a 100,000-class cleanroom environment. This ensures our products
meet stringent requirements for low particulate and low microbial counts from the very source,
providing a clean and reliable guarantee for high-end medical device packaging and sterile
healthcare products.

15
Dedicated Production Lines

We operate 15 specialized production lines. This setup provides formidable production capacity and
flexible configuration, enabling us to efficiently fulfill orders ranging from large-scale volume
demands to customized needs with rapid response, ensuring reliable and on-time delivery.

8000 *m²*
Production

Our 8,000㎡ production base is operated by a dedicated team of 50+ experienced professionals. This
combination of substantial infrastructure and focused workforce ensures not only efficient workflow
and scalable capacity, but also consistent, hands-on expertise throughout every stage of your order
— from planning to delivery.
* [
  [jlblock35]
  
  ### Industry Advantages
  
  Specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of medical-grade hygiene papers, our core offerings
  include medical hand towels, postpartum care pads, ultrasound wipes, and disposable facial wipes.
  Equipped with patented 5C cleanroom technology and a GMP Class 100,000 sterile workshop, we ensure
  product safety and efficacy. Our extensive product line features diverse specifications to meet
  varied application needs. With partnerships spanning over 300 top-tier hospitals, we have earned
  widespread market recognition.
  
  ][164]
* [
  [jlblock36]
  
  ### Research and Development Expenditures
  
  The company is deeply committed to the research and development of antimicrobial, sterilization,
  and disinfection processes for paper products, offering multiple reliable solutions including
  high-temperature treatment, ethylene oxide sterilization, irradiation, and quaternary ammonium
  compounds. We enforce internal cleanliness standards far exceeding industry and corporate
  benchmarks (colony count <5), ensuring the foundational safety of our products. Our proprietary
  “Crystal Diamond Embossing” technology leads the industry, and through continuous R&D, we pursue
  higher standards to empower products to achieve comprehensive excellence—from safety to user
  experience.
  
  ][165]
* [
  [jlblock37]
  
  ### OEM/ODM
  
  We offer one-stop services ranging from standard products to deep customization. Whether it's
  product specifications, packaging design, wholesale, or OEM/ODM partnerships, we provide flexible
  solutions. Transparency is the cornerstone of our collaboration: from raw material selection and
  production processes to final delivery, every critical step is transparently accessible to clients
  for real-time tracking and traceability. You can monitor production progress and quality details
  at any time, enabling fully visual communication throughout the process. This ensures every stage
  meets expectations and standards, making collaboration more efficient and worry-free.

## COMPANY

# **Manufacturer of High Quality Towel, Tissue, and Napkins**


Novex Products Inc., is a growing manufacturer of tissue, towel, and napkin products. Our products
are designed for applications in the away-from-home market as well as retail consumptions. In
addition to our standard items, we also manufacture custom made paper products per customer
specifications. We use earth friendly materials and components in our products. We manufacture a
wide range of products and strive to be a one-stop shop to all distributors of janitorial, food
service, and paper products. Our products are consistent, elegant, cost effective, and eco-friendly.

Novex Products Inc., is a growing manufacturer of tissue, towel, and napkin products. Our products
are designed for applications in the away-from-home market as well as retail consumptions. In
addition to our standard items, we also manufacture custom made paper products per customer
specifications. We use earth friendly materials and components in our products. We manufacture a
wide range of products and strive to be a one-stop shop to all distributors of janitorial, food
service, and paper products. Our products are consistent, elegant, cost effective, and eco-friendly.

[Plans and Pricing][13] [Request a Demo][14] [Free Newsletter][15]

## The Panjiva Difference

Panjiva is an intelligence platform that’s bringing transparency to global trade through our robust
global coverage, powerful machine-learning technologies, and dynamic data visualizations. Whether
you’re looking to identify potential business partners, keep track of competitors, or find
investment signals, our platform arms you with unrivaled insights to make supply chain decisions
with conviction. [Learn more][16]

## Smart & Intuitive Analytics

Our platform takes the power of **machine learning** and **data visualization** to give you clear,
actionable insights on global trade.

[Watch Demo][17]

## Find and evaluate legitimate businesses, faster

### 9 million companies and over 2 billion shipment records, just a few seconds away

#### Search for Importers and Exports

Our technology gives you immediate insight into the companies involved at every node of
international supply chains. From manufacturers and buyers to shipping and logistics, Panjiva allows
customers to better understand trade around the globe.

#### Take the data with you

Building a lead list for your sales team? Easily export the results and share them with your team to
expand their reach.

[[Screenshot-supplier-search-for-shirts]][18]
[Supplier Search for shirts]

#### Search your way

Whether you are searching for a product by name or classification, we make it easy. We support
commodity name, HS / HTS code, *D-U-N-S® Number*, and location-based searches.

#### Receive periodic email alerts

Save your search and receive email alerts anytime a new company matches your search criteria, or
when an existing company has new shipment activity.

## A Clear View of Each Company’s Activities

### Information and insights from authoritative customs and business information databases melded
### together to give a 360 degree view of businesses worldwide.

[[An example Panjiva Profile]][19]
[An example Panjiva Profile]

#### Actionable Insights

Powerful reporting capabilities let you spot trends in the import and export activities businesses
across the globe.

#### Top Customers & Suppliers

Discover new opportunities by seeing who does business with your peers or competitors.

#### Contact Information

Access the emails or phone numbers of key decision makers on over 1 million companies.

## A Comprehensive View of Global Trade

### We provide our clients with transactional data covering 35% of global trade flows.
### Armed with this data, you can decide where and when to invest.

#### Competitive Insights

Understand your market share by seeing where your competitors source their goods, and which entities
are involved in the shipment of goods.

#### Risk Analysis

Use our [platform][20] to analyze trade lanes or identify which companies have the riskiest supply
chains.

#### Sales Leads

Whether you’re targeting buyers, suppliers, NVOCCs, or carriers, Panjiva makes it easy to identify
the best sales prospects, learn more about their business, and make contact.

#### Xpressfeed™ Access Available

Use [Xpressfeed™][21] to push leads directly into your CRM system or feed data about publicly-traded
companies into your quant models.

reliability you expect from the first sheet to the last.
